mapper.sql: config_key, config_value, sensitive_flag, value_ciphertext, value_mask, encryption_algorithm, encryption_key_id, config_type, description
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config ( config_key, config_value, sensitive_flag, value_ciphertext, value_mask, encryption_algorithm, encryption_key_id, config_type, description ) VALUES ( #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{sensitiveFlag}, #{valueCiphertext}, #{valueMask}, #{encryptionAlgorithm}, #{encryptionKeyId}, #{configType}, #{description} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), sensitive_flag = VALUES(sensitive_flag), value_ciphertext = VALUES(value_ciphertext), value_mask = VALUES(value_mask), encryption_algorithm = VALUES(encryption_algorithm), encryption_key_id = VALUES(encryption_key_id), config_type = VALUES(config_type), description = VALUES(description)
